description: Convert an OD600 reading to a cell density and a total cell count, correcting for the optical path and any dilution, and flagging the two things that silently make the number wrong: a reading above the linear range (a dense culture reads LOW), and a plate-reader path length assumed to be a cuvette's 1 cm. Also plans a back-dilution to a target OD. The cells-per-OD factor is a convention, not a constant — it varies with strain, growth phase and instrument, so pass factorPerOd when you have calibrated against plate counts.

dilutionFactor.description: Dilution done before reading (2 means the sample was diluted 1:2).

factorPerOd.description: Your own calibration: cells/mL at OD600 = 1.0 in a 1 cm path. Overrides organism.

organism.description: Supplies the cells-per-OD factor. Ignored when factorPerOd is given.

pathLengthCm.description: Optical path of the reading. A cuvette is 1 cm; 200 µL in a 96-well flat plate is about 0.58 cm.

targetOd.description: Optional: plan a back-dilution to this OD. 0 = skip.

targetVolumeMl.description: Final volume for the back-dilution plan.

volumeMl.description: Culture volume, for a total cell count. 0 = not given.

name: od600_cells
title: OD600 to cells/mL
